title: The things that stay
intro: Pietrolino says goodbye to a friend and discovers that what he learned from him stays. At home the child chooses an object or a gesture that reminds them of someone far away and tells about it: this activity is done without the tablet.

8-10.goal: Put a name to what you feel for someone far away and choose a concrete way to keep the bond.
steps: The child thinks of a person or a friend they see less than before.
They choose an object at home or a gesture that reminds them of that person.
With the adult they write or draw three things that stay, even if you see each other less.
They tell someone in the family about it, when they want to.
materials: a sheet of paper and a pencil or colours
preparation: Think beforehand about who might come to mind, so you are not caught off guard.

supervision.note: Listen, and write for them if they ask. If the separation is a bereavement or a family break-up, this activity is not enough: the child needs a trusted person beside them.

alternatives: Instead of the object, a song, a dish or a word you used together.
Instead of the list, a letter or a drawing to send to the person, if possible.
